instruction: I'm using Ubuntu. Please set Nautilus as the default file manager for my system.

metadata.explanation: Task variation that sets Nautilus as the default file manager. Uses custom getter get_default_file_manager__a1cf9be3 which checks the inode/directory MIME type handler using xdg-mime query. Evaluates that the default file manager includes 'nautilus.desktop'.
